name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand, bend your knees slightly, and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Draw both elbows up alongside your torso so your upper arms are parallel to the floor and your elbows are bent roughly 90 degrees.
Keeping your upper arms locked in place, extend both elbows backward until your arms are straight and your triceps are fully contracted.
Bend your elbows with control to lower the dumbbells back to the starting angle.
tips: Keep your upper arms pinned high beside your ribs instead of letting your elbows swing forward and back.
Choose a manageable weight so you can pause briefly at full extension without swinging.
